title: 直接拖曳整理動作列與更多
summary: 設定頁以抓取手掌提示可拖曳項目，並支援跨區搬移與右鍵操作，整理常用動作更順手。
highlights: 把手與名稱使用抓取手掌游標，拖動時顯示握住狀態與清楚落點。
可在動作列與更多之間雙向拖曳，保留顯示狀態並遵守九項容量限制。
右鍵即可搬移、顯示或隱藏動作；自訂動作也能編輯、複製、匯出與刪除。
usage: 開啟設定的動作列頁，拖曳項目把手或名稱，或在項目上按右鍵。搜尋期間請使用位置下拉選單或右鍵搬移；不需額外安裝。

en.title: Drag actions between the action bar and More
en.summary: Grab cursors, cross-group dragging and context menus make organizing frequently used actions easier.
highlights: Handles and names show an open hand, changing to a closed hand while dragging with clear drop feedback.
Move actions in either direction between the action bar and More while preserving visibility and the nine-action limit.
Right-click to move, show or hide actions; custom actions also offer edit, duplicate, export and delete commands.
en.usage: Open the action bar settings and drag an action's handle or name, or right-click the action. While searching, use the placement dropdown or context menu. No additional installation is required.
